tasks.title: Arrive for check-in
tasks.detail: Please arrive by 10:00 AM for check-in.
tasks.quote: Please arrive by: 10:00 AM for check-in

tasks.title: Arrive 30 minutes before the appointment time
tasks.detail: Arrive 30 minutes before your appointment time to complete check-in and forms.
tasks.quote: Arrive 30 minutes before your appointment time to complete check-in and forms.

tasks.title: Bring photo ID and insurance card
tasks.detail: Bring both items to the appointment.
tasks.quote: Bring a photo ID and your insurance card.

tasks.title: Bring referral/order form and previous imaging reports if available
tasks.detail: Bring your referral/order form and any previous imaging reports if you have them.
tasks.quote: Bring your referral/order form and any previous imaging reports if you have them.

tasks.title: No fasting is required
tasks.detail: You may eat and drink as normal before this exam.
tasks.quote: No fasting is required for this exam. You may eat and drink as you normally do.

tasks.title: Wear clothing without metal
tasks.detail: Wear comfortable clothing without metal zippers, snaps, or buckles.
tasks.quote: Wear comfortable clothing without metal zippers, snaps, or buckles.

tasks.title: Leave metal items at home
tasks.detail: Leave jewelry, watches, hairpins, and other metal items at home.
tasks.quote: Leave jewelry, watches, hairpins, and other metal items at home.

tasks.title: Complete MRI safety screening at check-in
tasks.detail: You will complete an MRI safety screening form at check-in.
tasks.quote: You will complete an MRI safety screening form at check-in.

tasks.title: Tell the technologist about implanted devices or metal
tasks.detail: Tell the technologist if you have any implanted medical device or metal in your body.
tasks.quote: Tell the technologist if you have any implanted medical device or metal in your body.

tasks.title: Keep the insurance letter and watch for a decision
tasks.detail: Keep the letter. If no decision arrives before the appointment, contact Member Services.
tasks.quote: Keep this letter. If you do not receive a decision before your appointment, contact Member Services at 555-0199.

tasks.title: Call to reschedule at least 24 hours before if needed
tasks.detail: If you need to reschedule, call 555-0142 at least 24 hours before your appointment.
tasks.quote: If you need to reschedule, call 555-0142 at least 24 hours before your appointment.

discrepancies.summary: The documents give two different arrival instructions: one says arrive by 10:00 AM, and another says arrive 30 minutes before the appointment time.
